entities.summary: The Krue Se Mosque also called Gresik Mosque, Pitu Krue-ban Mosque, Pintu Gerbang Mosque, or Sultan Muzaffar Shah Mosque, is a mosque, located in the Pattani Province of Thailand. Its construction may have begun in the 16th century. The surviving structure is described as having a mixture of Middle Eastern or European architectural styles.
